name: B10-0480/2026 (Renew) – Escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text:
**What it asks for**

This is an opinion, not a law. The European Parliament asks Russia to stop attacking ships and ports in the Black Sea. It wants the EU to set up a maritime security centre in Constanța and Varna, to protect shipping and grain exports, and to add sanctions on those responsible. It also asks NATO to step up surveillance and counter-drone defences along the coasts of Romania and Bulgaria.

**In short**

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament calls for a Black Sea security hub, more sanctions and NATO help.
- **Who it affects:** Seafarers, shipping firms, Romania and Bulgaria, and countries that import Ukrainian grain.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council, the Commission and NATO. They decide whether to act.
